summary: Homelab MetaMCP GitOps changes are implemented and locally validated; the runtime-only credential transfer, merge/reconcile, OAuth redirect update, and live seven-server protocol checks remain for later pipeline stages.
validation: Commit b8460fd pins MetaMCP 2.4.22 and PostgreSQL to immutable digests.
helm lint passed for charts/metamcp and observability.
MetaMCP render contains the Traefik-only NetworkPolicy and immutable images.
Grafana MCP 0.20.0 render uses image 1.1.0, the runtime token Secret, and --disable-write.
Tempo render enables query_frontend.mcp_server.enabled and Grafana targets the live Tempo service.
Disposable PostgreSQL bootstrap passed twice with protected environment variables and redacted output.
git diff --check and the scoped credential-pattern scan passed; graphify-out remains unstaged.
Draft PR #439 references issue #435 and contains no runtime credentials.
blockers: Runtime-only Grafana Viewer, ArgoCD readonly, and GitHub credential transfer still need live provisioning after review.
The PR must merge and explicit homelab Argo reconciliation must complete before live protocol validation.
AuthentiK needs the public MetaMCP callback URI and the public DNS/OAuth metadata flow still needs end-to-end proof.
Per-server discovery, tool lists, safe calls, and target-isolation checks are pending the live registry bootstrap.
next_action: Review the committed GitOps diff and then proceed through the pipeline review and test stages before live credential provisioning and reconciliation.
independent_lanes: Homelab GitOps and immutable workload release
Secret-safe MetaMCP registry and target matrix
Public OAuth and ChatGPT protocol readiness
Per-server live discovery and safe-call validation

issues.details: The public ingress is declared, but the callback registration, public DNS, metadata, PKCE challenge, and ChatGPT connection still require live proof.
